hypothesis.statement: The vertical-GRF dynamic range (loading peak minus mid-stance trough) differs across the five GaitRec gait classes -- healthy control (n=208), ankle (n=483), knee (n=499), hip (n=364) and calcaneus (n=290) pathology; the newly-authored oneWayAnova reproduces base R stats::oneway.test(var.equal=TRUE) BIT-FOR-BIT and scipy.stats.f_oneway to machine precision. Healthy controls have a larger dynamic range than the pooled pathology classes.

analysis_plan.dataset: GaitRec (Horsak et al. 2020); vertical-GRF dynamic range (peak1 - trough via PhysioMoCap::grfLandmarks) across the five gait classes, shod, standardised walking speed, initial-presentation baseline sessions

decision.threshold: descriptive: oneWayAnova equals base R oneway.test(var.equal=TRUE) bit-for-bit (|diff| = 0) and scipy.stats.f_oneway to machine precision (|diff| < 1e-9); the group means differ (omnibus F, p < 0.001) with the healthy-control dynamic range exceeding the pooled pathology dynamic range
